standard.title: Develop comprehension and cultural meaning strategies
standard.description: develop strategies to comprehend and adjust the target language in familiar contexts to convey cultural meaning
standard.prior_knowledge: Students have noticed that language carries cultural meaning (AC9LS2C04) and use formulaic expressions in context. They have not yet developed explicit strategies for comprehending unfamiliar language or adjusting language to convey cultural meaning.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students develop and apply strategies to comprehend unfamiliar target language and to adjust language for cultural meaning — including contextual cues, vocabulary tools, formality awareness and cultural explanation.

nodes.label: Comprehension strategies for unfamiliar language
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can apply strategies to work out the meaning of unfamiliar target language — using context, vocabulary patterns, surrounding words and available reference tools.
nodes.minimum_width: Apply at least two different strategies to work out the meaning of unfamiliar words or expressions in a given text — and identify which strategy was used.
nodes.typical_width: Use context and surrounding words to infer meaning; apply vocabulary pattern recognition; use dictionaries and reference tools; apply literacy skills from English to support comprehension; notice word families and patterns; consider audience and purpose as comprehension aids.
wider: Apply multiple strategies to the same unfamiliar word and compare which gives the most accurate result — develop a personal strategy priority for target language comprehension
Explain to a partner how they worked out the meaning of an unfamiliar word — articulating the reasoning strategy explicitly
nodes.hinge_reason: Comprehension strategies are what allow students to function with authentic and partially unfamiliar texts. Students who can only understand pre-taught vocabulary are dependent on teacher pre-loading and cannot access texts independently — which is required for research and text engagement tasks from this band onwards.

response_modes.reason: Strategy application must be made explicit before it becomes automatic. Students need to name and practise each strategy deliberately before they can deploy them spontaneously.

success_criteria: Applies at least two comprehension strategies to work out the meaning of unfamiliar words in a text
Can identify which strategy was used for at least one word and explain the reasoning

nodes.label: Adjusting language for formality and cultural meaning
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can recognise when formality adjustment is needed and apply appropriate levels of formality and cultural conventions in familiar target language contexts.
nodes.minimum_width: Identify at least two situations requiring different levels of formality and use appropriate language in each.
nodes.typical_width: Apply formality distinctions across contexts; compare target language and English expressions for cultural nuance; identify culturally specific expressions that require explanation to non-target-language speakers; compare signs and expressions across cultural contexts; comment on culturally specific elements of texts.
wider: Identify a culturally specific expression that has no direct English equivalent — explain what cultural knowledge is needed to understand it and produce a cultural explanation for a non-target-language speaker
Compare the level of formality in two versions of the same social situation — explain every language difference and the cultural reason for it

response_modes.reason: Formality and cultural meaning adjustment is built by encountering the full range of social contexts that require different language choices.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Explaining target language cultural expressions to non-target-language speakers — making cultural knowledge explicit — is where intercultural awareness becomes genuinely transferable.
success_criteria: Uses appropriate formality in at least two different social contexts with evidence of deliberate selection
Identifies at least one target language expression that carries cultural meaning beyond its literal translation and explains the cultural content
